city.title: City view
city.intro: What MiceMax could be worth to Sapporo, estimated from simulated attendee behaviour at the two demo conferences and the money formula applied to every listed conference in the next 12 months.
city.formula: attendees reached × extra-night rate (end weekday × overseas share × long weekend) × spend per extra night + activity take-up × average activity price. Early, Middle and Strong are three uptake assumptions.
